```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
raw_data <- read.csv("PIE-PlantShoot_2004-2019.csv")

summary(raw_data)
head(raw_data)

```

```{r}
new_data <- raw_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Species, Creek, Branch, Transect, Shoot.Mass) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Shoot.Mass)) %>% 
  group_by(Year, Creek, Branch, Transect, Species) %>%
  summarise(mean_mass = mean(Shoot.Mass)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Creek, Branch, Transect) %>%
  summarise(sum_mass = sum(mean_mass)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Creek, Branch) %>%
  summarise(shoot_mass = mean(sum_mass))

new_data
write.csv(new_data, "PIE-PlantShoot_2004-2019_Processed.csv")
```
